description: Start a configured set of named AI sessions in detached terminals
author: Serg Parf and agent-bus contributors

start.help: Start every configured session; confirm its bus reader within 20s or report failure and an output tail

help.help: Describe calls, Configuration and secret declarations

tag.help: Optional set-wide record tag, combined with each session’s tags

sessions.help: List (maximum 32) of {name,runtime,cwd,tmux?,args?,tags?}; tmux: optional case-sensitive name [A-Za-z0-9_-], 1..32 characters, unique in the set; runtime: claude|codex|opencode; cwd: existing absolute directory; at most 64 args and 32 tags per entry
